tmux Cheat Sheet

Searchable reference of 60+ real tmux keybindings and commands — sessions, windows, panes, copy mode.

Keys / CommandSectionDescription

C-b = Ctrl+b, the default tmux prefix. Bindings are tmux 3.x defaults.

📖 How to use

  1. Type in the search box to filter bindings instantly.
  2. Use the section dropdown to browse one area.
  3. Click a row to copy the keybinding.
  4. C-b means Ctrl+b, the default prefix key.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many entries are listed?

Over 60 real bindings and commands across sessions, windows, panes, copy mode and misc.

What does C-b mean?

Hold Ctrl and press b — the default tmux prefix. Press it first, then the listed key.

Are these the default bindings?

Yes — defaults for tmux 3.x. Custom configs may remap some keys.

Can I copy a binding?

Click any row to copy the keybinding or command to your clipboard.
